title: fix(app-shell,core): the record page's Undo captures only what the record carries, through core's one capture rule (objectui#11082)
body:
Fixes #11082
Clause-②: yes — `captureUpdateUndoData` becomes a named export of `@object-ui/core`, a new published symbol (`minor` on `@object-ui/core`). Its answers do not change. No declared type or accepted key moves.

## What was wrong

`RecordDetailView`'s own `api` handler built the Undo snapshot of an undoable single-record update as `pageRecord[k] ?? null`. That is the shape objectui#10404 removed from `ActionRunner` and `useConsoleActionRuntime`. The page record is read by `findOne` with no column list, but ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` deletes every field the reader may not read. So when an undoable record-page action writes a field the reader cannot read, the field is absent from `pageRecord`, `null` is captured, and pressing Undo writes `null` over the stored value.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/core`**: `captureUpdateUndoData(writtenFields, rowRecord)` in `ActionRunner.ts` is now exported by name. The package barrel already re-exports `ActionRunner.ts` through `actions/index.ts`, so no barrel line changed. The function body is unchanged. `rowCarries` stays private.
- **`RecordDetailView`** (`api` handler, generic `default` branch): the snapshot is `captureUpdateUndoData(Object.keys(params), pageRecord)`. When it answers `undefined`, no undoable op is returned, so the runner pushes nothing and the success toast carries no Undo button. The write still happens. A `console.warn` naming the missing fields fires after the successful write, the same diagnostic the runner and the console runtime give. A carried value, `null` included, is captured as before.
- **`useConsoleActionRuntime`** (`api` handler, generic branch): the inline copy of the rule is replaced by a call to `captureUpdateUndoData`, so one rule remains. Its warning and its `missing` list are unchanged. The list is derived per field through the same helper (`captureUpdateUndoData([k], row) === undefined`), so there is no second copy of the "carries" predicate.
- **`packages/core/README.md`**: a short section documents the new export (AGENTS.md #2). The README documents exported helpers section by section, and `check:readme-exports` now judges this import.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/11082-detail-undo-capture.md`: `'@object-ui/core': minor`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

The `` description: action.label || `Undo ${targetObject}` `` fallback that objectui#11080 owns is kept byte-for-byte. It moved two spaces right into the new `if (undoData)` block, so objectui#11080 will rebase onto the re-indented line.

## Pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.undoCapture-11082.test.tsx` runs the real view. A probe inside the view's own `ActionProvider` hands back `execute`, so the action runs through the real runner, the view's `api` handler, and the view's toast handler. The Undo button is the success toast's `action`; pressing it runs the real `useGlobalUndo`.
  - A written field the page record does not carry (the FLS-masked case) gives no Undo button, no op on the undo stack, and a warning with `missing: ['status']`. The write still happens.
  - A carried field next to an uncarried one gives no Undo at all (no partial Undo).
  - A carried `null` is restored as `null`.
  - A carried value is restored as that value.
- `packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/captureUpdateUndoData.export-11082.test.ts`: the package entry exports the function, it is the runner module's own function, and it answers as before. That covers carried values, carried `null`, an absent field, a partial set, an own key holding `undefined`, and an inherited key.

**Ablation** (fix committed first; mutation and restore through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode): the anchor `const undoData = captureUpdateUndoData(written, record);` in `RecordDetailView.tsx` was replaced by the pre-fix `record[k] ?? null` loop. Result: 1 hit, blob `33aab695363d` changed to `131c67079e99`. The pin then read `Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)`: the uncarried case and the partial case failed with `AssertionError: expected { …(8) } to be undefined`. The carried-`null` and carried-value cases stayed green, as expected, since `?? null` also answers correctly for them. Restore: blob equals HEAD (`33aab695363d`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No `dist/` is involved, because the test imports the view by relative path and vitest aliases `@object-ui/core` to `packages/core/src`.

## Local verification (at `251bd2a05`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose packages/core/src/actions/ packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.undoCapture-11082.test.tsx`: `Test Files  31 passed (31)` / `Tests  479 passed (479)`. All 5 core pins and all 4 app-shell pins are listed.
- Every test file that imports or mocks `useConsoleActionRuntime` or `RecordDetailView` (73 files, found by `git grep` over import, `import()` and `vi.mock` specifiers; the 10404, 11056 and 11082 pins are included): `Test Files  73 passed (73)` / `Tests  591 passed (591)`.
- Dependency closure built first: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28/28 tasks), then the `check:doc-snippets` build scope (35/35). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check`: exit 0. Both run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the tests are compiled too.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 5 changed TS files: exit 0, 0 errors. The diff adds no `any` and removes one `as any`.
- Exit 0 for each of: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:readme-exports` (`552 real, 0 wrong-path, 0 fabricated`, with the new `captureUpdateUndoData` row judged `real`), `check:doc-snippets` (`682 of 682 block(s) judged, 0 failed`), `check:doc-fences`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:self-import`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 7 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

**Declared narrowing:** the whole app-shell suite was not run locally. The run covers the direct importers of both changed modules, not modules that reach them through a barrel. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` were not run either; those belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- No `content/docs` page documents the Undo capture rule. `content/docs/core/enhanced-actions.mdx` only names the Undo button's label. No docs page was added, since that is outside this card's file surface. The rule is documented in the core README section above.
- Observation, not filed (read-only inference, not reproduced; carrier: none): the page record is read with `$expand` on declared reference fields, and objectql writes the expanded record back under the same key. So an undoable record-page action that writes a lookup field would capture the expanded object, not the id, as the prior value. Whether the update route accepts that shape was not measured.
